story: Russian opposition leader Navalny dupes spy into revealing how he was poisoned
text: If you haven't seen the full investigation released last week I'd strongly recommend you check it out, top notch investigative journalism. The video has English subtitles: [LINK] Also here's the full phone call with the FSB agent, with english transcript: [VIDEO]

I highly recommend reading Bellingcat's investigation into the poisoning of Alexei Navalny and how they tracked down the individual FSB officers responsible: [LINK] It's the most impressive investigative work I have ever read. One can only imagine the capabilities of nation state actors if an NGO is capable of this. Even more incredible is that Alexei Navalny personally called an FSB officer and was able to extract a confession: [VIDEO]

In case you missed it: Navalny found conclusive evidence of a cover-up for his poisoning [1] [2] [3]. But the best part is how he did it: caller ID spoof + social engineering. IMO exploiting the authoritarian nature/culture was really clever. Every time Kudryavtsev demurs about revealing more details, Navalny (as Ustinov) calls him by his full name. To me, it sounds like he's threatening him or reminding him of their relative position in the hierarchy. Each time, Kudryavtsev continues to spill the beans and give up co-conspirators.
